About the Team

The DashMart Growth team is responsible for accelerating consumer growth across DoorDash's first-party retail business. We own the strategies that drive customer acquisition, retention, order frequency, and long-term profitability by partnering across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Business Development. Within DashMart, this role will focus on our DashMart Fulfillment Services business.

DashMart Fulfillment Services (DFS) transforms DashMart from a standalone retailer into the fulfillment platform powering merchant ecommerce on and off DoorDash. DFS enables traditional grocers to accelerate toward best-in-class quality and economics while giving consumers faster, higher-quality delivery from the brands and selection they already trust. Pricing is one of our most important growth levers. As DashMart evolves from a convenience business to powering local grocery through DashMart Fulfillment Services (DFS), we're reimagining how pricing, promotions, affordability, and merchandising work together to deliver compelling customer value while maintaining sustainable economics. We're looking for entrepreneurial builders who enjoy solving ambiguous problems, using data to inform strategy, and turning insights into scalable customer experiences.

About the Role

As Senior Manager on our DashMart Strategy & Operations team, you will define and lead DashMart's pricing strategy across our consumer businesses, including DashMart and DashMart Fulfillment Services.

You will own the strategic roadmap for pricing and affordability, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Operations, Marketing, and Business Development to identify opportunities that improve customer value, accelerate growth, and strengthen unit economics. This role requires a strategic operator who can move seamlessly between executive strategy, deep analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional execution. You'll build the long-term pricing vision while also rolling up your sleeves to solve complex problems and launch new capabilities.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

• Own DashMart's pricing strategy and roadmap, identifying opportunities across pricing architecture, affordability, promotions, fees, and merchandising to drive customer growth while balancing profitability.
• Use a data driven approach to develop pricing frameworks that support different customer missions—from convenience and top-up grocery to weekly stock-up—and evolve our pricing approach as our business expands.
• Translate strategy into execution by working across Product, Engineering, Finance, Analytics, Operations, and Business Development to launch new pricing capabilities and scale successful programs.
• Serve as the cross-functional leader for pricing, aligning executive stakeholders around recommendations and balancing customer experience, merchant relationships, operational complexity, and financial outcomes
Create repeatable pricing playbooks, operating rhythms, dashboards, and decision frameworks that enable DashMart to make faster, higher-quality pricing decisions as the business grows.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 8+ years of experience in Strategy & Operations, management consulting, growth, pricing, marketplace strategy, or a related analytical function.
• You are analytical. You have deep analytical skills and are comfortable working with large datasets using SQL and BI tools.
• You are AI native. You're AI-forward and leveraging automation, LLMs, and emerging technologies to accelerate analysis, improve decision-making, and increase team leverage. Experience in Claude & Cursor is a plus.

Fort de plus de 20 ans d'expérience et de succès, nous mettons notre passion et notre créativité au service du jeu et d’histoires inoubliables. Pour le plaisir de tous.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, nous recherchons un·e Juriste Senior - DPO & Conformité IA.

Vos missions :

Rattaché·e à la Directrice Juridique Groupe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le déploiement et l'animation du dispositif de conformité du groupe PulluP. En autonomie, vous accompagnerez de manière opérationnelle l’ensemble de nos métiers et filiales sur les enjeux cruciaux liés à la protection des données personnelles et à l'encadrement de l'Intelligence Artificielle.

Au sein de la Direction Juridique, vous pourrez également être amené(e) à prêter main-forte sur d'autres thématiques transverses relatives à la conformité globale du Groupe.

À ce titre, vous intervenez notamment sur les missions suivantes :

1) Gouvernance & Suivi de la Conformité

•

Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route de conformité (Data & IA) et en assurer le déploiement à l'échelle du Groupe.

•

Rédiger, déployer et tenir à jour l'ensemble des politiques et documents légaux liés à la Data et à l'IA (Privacy Policies, politiques cookies, chartes IA internes, CGU, procédures de gestion de crise), en tenant compte des spécificités du secteur du jeu vidéo (données de mineurs, AdTech, outils anti-triche).

•

Élaborer un reporting régulier et précis sur l'état de la conformité de votre périmètre pour la direction du Groupe PulluP.

•

Être l’interlocuteur des autres autorités de contrôle concernées (CNIL, DGCCRF, ARCOM, ANSSI, etc.).

•

Assurer une veille réglementaire et jurisprudentielle proactive (Data & IA) pour anticiper les impacts sur les activités du groupe.

2) Conformité RGPD & Opérationnel

•

Gérer la conformité des traitements de données au quotidien : tenue et mise à jour du registre, réalisation des analyses d'impact (AIPD), audits internes, identification des risques et suivi des plans de remédiation.

•

Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques et la sécurité des systèmes d'information (DSI/RSSI) sur la sécurisation des données pour assurer la gestion des incidents de sécurité (incluant la préparation des notifications aux autorités) dans les délais impartis.

•

Traiter les demandes d'exercice de droits dans les délais impartis.

•

Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans la mise œuvre de projet impliquant le traitement de données personnelles en procédant à l'évaluation des impacts et risques associés (privacy by design).

3) Déploiement & Sécurisation de l'IA (AI Act)

•

Accompagner opérationnellement les équipes dans le déploiement de leurs projets d'Intelligence Artificielle en procédant à l'évaluation des risques associés (compliance by design).

•

Mettre en œuvre et documenter les processus de conformité IA (contrôles, traçabilité) pour garantir le respect de l'AI Act et des réglementations applicables.

4) Conseil, Négociation & Sensibilisation

•

Accompagnement des équipes Marketing sur les sujets AdTech (cookies, pixels, SDK, ciblage publicitaire, etc.).

•

Conseiller les équipes opérationnelles et négocier les clauses contractuelles relatives à la Data et à l'IA avec nos fournisseurs et partenaires.

•

Concevoir et animer des actions de sensibilisation et de formation à destination des différentes directions du groupe.

쿠팡이츠 소개

쿠팡이츠는 다양한 맛집의 맛있는 음식은 물론 편의점, 마트, 꽃집 등 리테일 매장의 상품까지 여러분의 집 앞까지 빠르고 정확하게 배달해주는 쿠팡의 서비스입니다. 쿠팡이츠에서는 소비자, 배달파트너, 매장이라는 세 가지 고객군 모두에게 원활한 경험을 제공하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있습니다.

직무소개

쿠팡이츠 Visual Design 팀은 소비자, 배달파트너, 매장, 광고 비즈니스, 퀵커머스 등 다양한 제품과 비즈니스 영역 전반에서 시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험을 설계합니다.

시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험은 단순히 아름다운 화면이 아니라, 고객이 더 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 행동할 수 있도록 도움으로써 제품의 신뢰를 높입니다.

Staff Product Visual Designer는 뛰어난 비주얼 디자인 역량을 바탕으로 기능이나 프로젝트를 넘어, 제품 전반에 걸친 시각적 경험을 발전시키며, 나아가 조직 전체의 비주얼 퀄리티를 지속적으로 높이는 역할을 합니다.

AI가 디자인 생산성을 빠르게 향상시키고 있지만, 문제를 정의하고 고객과 비즈니스의 목표를 이해한 뒤 적절한 해결 방법을 판단하는 일은 여전히 디자이너의 역할입니다. 우리 팀에서는 새로운 도구를 적극 활용하면서도 탁월한 디자인 판단으로 쿠팡이츠의 시각적으로 일관된 고객 경험(Visual Customer Experience)을 리드할 디자이너를 찾고 있습니다.

주요 업무

• 쿠팡이츠 및 글로벌 제품에서 시각적 원칙과 다양한 디자인 접근을 활용해 고객이 더 쉽고 빠르게 이해하고 행동할 수 있는 시각적 경험을 구현합니다.

• 고객과 비즈니스 목표에 대한 깊은 이해를 바탕으로 가장 효과적인 시각적 솔루션을 제시합니다.

• 비주얼 디자인 원칙, 에셋, 가이드라인을 구축해 제품, 브랜드, 비즈니스 전반에서 일관된 비주얼 디자인 시스템을 만듭니다.

• Product Designer, Product Manager, Engineer, Marketing, Business Strategy 등 다양한 이해관계자와 협업하며 복잡한 프로젝트를 운영 관리하고, 디자인 방향성과 의사결정을 리드합니다.

• 명확한 디자인 원칙을 통해 조직 전체의 비주얼 디자인 수준을 지속적으로 높입니다.

• AI 기반 디자인 워크플로우와 새로운 디자인 도구를 적극 활용하여 반복적인 작업을 줄이고, 더 높은 수준의 문제 해결에 집중합니다.

• 디자인 리뷰, 멘토링, 프로젝트 리딩 등을 통해 다른 디자이너의 성장을 지원합니다.

자격 요건

• 비주얼 가이드라인, 디자인 시스템을 정의하거나 발전시킨 경험이 있는 분.

• 한 명 이상의 디자이너를 이끌며 프로젝트를 주도적으로 리드한 경험이 있으며, 디자인 리뷰, 멘토링 등을 통해 다른 디자이너의 성장을 지원한 경험이 있는 분.

Job Description

Summary

We're looking for a Data Engineer at the Analyst level to join our Data Lake team. You'll build and maintain data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Spark, Databricks, and Airflow, contributing to the reliability and quality of the corporate data lake. This is an intermediate role where you'll work under moderate supervision on defined tasks while building deeper expertise in lakehouse architecture.

At Pismo, the Data Lake team is responsible for centralizing and organizing data into a single, trusted platform that supports decision-making across the company and for external clients. We work on challenges such as scaling global data infrastructure, delivering high-quality reporting, and enabling secure, self-service access to data—helping teams move faster while avoiding information silos.

What You'll Do:

• Develop, test, and maintain data pipelines (ingestion, transformation, quality checks) using PySpark/SparkSQL on Databricks.

• Build and modify Airflow DAGs (MWAA) for pipeline orchestration.

• Write and optimize SQL queries for data transformation and validation.

• Support data quality by implementing and monitoring quality checks (Great Expectations or equivalent).

• Participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving feedback.

• Investigate pipeline failures and data quality issues with guidance from senior engineers.

• Write and maintain documentation for datasets and pipelines you build.
• Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives.

• Follow CI/CD, testing, and governance standards defined by the team.

This is a remote position. A remote position does not require job duties be performed within proximity of a Visa office location. Remote positions may be required to be present at a Visa office with scheduled notice. #LI‑Remote

Qualifications

For this role, you must be based in Brazil

Language Skills

• Proficiency in English at B2 level or above (Upper-Intermediate)

Basic Qualifications

• 3+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's or Associate’s Degree OR 5+ years of relevant work experience.
• Python for automation and data processing
• Data pipeline concepts (batch, ETL/ELT patterns)

Technical Skills

• Apache Spark basics (PySpark or SparkSQL)
• Databricks (jobs, workflows, cluster management, tuning)
• SQL (intermediate–advanced: joins, window functions, CTEs)
• Amazon S3 data lake design (partitioning, layout, lifecycle)
• Basic cloud concepts (AWS: S3, IAM, CloudWatch)
• Data modeling (dimensional / Kimball, medallion layers)
• Git/GitHub workflow and code review

Preferred Qualifications :

• Delta Lake (ACID tables, OPTIMIZE, VACUUM, schema evolution, MERGE)
• Apache Airflow / MWAA (DAG design, retries, backfills, SLAs)
• CDC patterns (DMS, incremental processing, MERGE upserts)
• Data quality concepts (validation, testing)
• Terraform basics
• BI integration (Superset, dashboarding)

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
직무 소개
Data Platform 조직의 Orchestration Platform 팀은 전체 비즈니스 도메인에 걸쳐 Job scheduling 및 execution 서비스를 제공합니다. Orchestration Platform 팀이 관리하는 인프라는 로그 분석, 추천, 가격 비교, AB 테스트, 검색 인덱싱, 광고 및 로켓 배송을 포함한 다양한 쿠팡 서비스와 관련된 데이터 처리를 제공합니다. 우리는 쿠팡 고객에게 최고의 전자상거래 경험을 제공하는 데 중요한 역할을 하고 있다고 확신합니다.
Orchestration Platform 팀은 클라우드 환경에서 매일 수십만 개의 Hive/Spark 작업을 처리하고 여러 클러스터에 걸쳐 수만 개의 Airflow DAG를 운영합니다. 이를 위해 Apache Airflow, Netflix Genie, Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Terraform과 같은 오픈 소스 기술과 Java 및 Python과 같은 개발 언어를 사용합니다.

jobs.description: Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a service that enables sellers to outsource supply chain and fulfillment to Amazon and use Amazon’s world-class technology, science and logistics infrastructure to deliver billions of products from manufacturing hubs to customer doorsteps worldwide with a fast delivery promise. The first twenty years of FBA made world-class fulfillment accessible to any seller. Our next chapter is about making speed accessible, giving sellers the tools, transparency, and control to deliver faster, in ways that make economic sense for their business. As the leader of Fast Delivery Programs product management, you will own the worldwide strategy for how sellers participate in Amazon's fastest delivery channels across North America, Europe, India, Latin America, and the Middle East. Customers increasingly expect delivery in hours, not days, and the categories driving that growth are where third-party sellers bring the depth and breadth customers need. But sub-same-day and quick commerce delivery are fundamentally different from the core fulfillment network. Selection is physically constrained, capacity is scarce, and every slot at a fast-delivery site has a cost. Deciding which products earn that space, which sellers get capacity, and what it should cost them is a new kind of product problem. Solving it means combining Amazon's algorithms with sellers' own demand signals. Your portfolio spans the full breadth of fast delivery: defining the worldwide speed strategy that governs how sellers participate in delivery speed across a portfolio of programs; designing and scaling mechanisms that allocate scarce capacity at speed nodes to sellers; building fee structures and seller incentive frameworks that align seller economics with network cost structures; optimizing product selection for capacity-constrained sites; designing seller-facing programs, communications, and workflows; and launching fast delivery programs architected from day one for worldwide scale. You'll start by leading a team of product and program managers, and partner with science and engineering to turn optimization and market mechanism design into products sellers use every day to grow their business and make money. We're looking for a leader who builds. You'll set the vision and develop a strong PM team, and you'll still get hands-on: prototyping new seller experiences and pricing concepts with AI tools, putting working versions in front of sellers and leaders within days, and making that the team's default way of working. The portfolio has grown into parallel tracks spanning supply chain, operations, delivery experience, fulfillment technology, and finance. Your job is to turn that into one coherent roadmap and shipped products with measurable positive seller outcomes. Key job responsibilities – Define the multi-year vision and worldwide roadmap for FBA fast delivery. Work backwards from customers' expectation of delivery in hours to expand selection, improve speed, and lower cost to serve. – Define how sellers participate in sub-same-day and quick commerce delivery channels across all geographies. – Design the end-to-end marketplace framework for fast delivery, spanning selection for limited shelf space, capacity allocation, inbound and inventory paths, seller recommendations and tools, and fee and incentive structures that align seller economics with customer outcomes. – Build seller-facing programs, tools, and communications that give sellers transparency, control, and a clear path to grow through faster delivery. – Partner with science and engineering to turn optimization models, market designs and seller insights into product features. Set technical direction and priorities and make architecture and scope tradeoffs. – Prototype new concepts yourself using AI coding, design and analysis tools. Validate ideas with working versions rather than long specs and build the same habits across your team. – Hire, lead, and develop a team of product and program managers and set a high bar for technical product ownership and engineering partnership. – Define the metrics framework for fast delivery (customer impact, seller outcomes, program health), and use it to drive investment decisions with VP-level leaders across supply chain, operations, seller and customer experience, and delivery. A day in the life One morning you might be working through how limited capacity at a new sub-same-day site should be split among thousands of sellers who all want in, and what it should cost them. By afternoon you could be demoing a working prototype of a seller capacity-request flow you built with AI tools, reviewing pilot results from a newly launched country, or coaching a PM through a tradeoff between speed and cost to serve. Your decisions will shape how millions of sellers reach Amazon's fastest delivery channels, and how billions of dollars in fulfillment investment turn into outcomes for customers and sellers. About the team FBA gives third-party sellers an end-to-end supply chain, from manufacturing sites to customers' doorsteps, so they can focus on growing their businesses. The team owns warehousing, inventory, fulfillment, pricing, and the recommendations that help sellers make the right decisions. We work closely with sellers to understand their experience, build agentic solutions for them, design seller policies and incentives, and develop products that help sellers and Amazon together delight customers worldwide. We also build the systems that manage inbound, transportation, and storage capacity, design a network that increases speed while reducing cost to serve, and run voice-of-seller systems that build seller trust. We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations: Bellevue, WA, or Sunnyvale, CA.

PlayStationのゲーム機本体、PS Portal、iOS/Android端末、PCなどを対象とする「ゲーム以外」のソフトウェアを開発・運用するチームの募集です。設計、実装、不具合修正、市場での使用・動作状況分析などを行っています。ご希望や経験に応じて、以下のいずれかの分野を担当していただきます。

・映像、音声、入力デバイスのストリーミング技術と応用

■職場紹介

PlayStationのユーザ体験を最高のものとするには、ゲームプレイそのものだけでなく、その前後や周辺におけるシステムの体験も重要です。私たちは、ユーザが直接使うアプリや機能、それらの共通フレームワーク、OSに近い基盤ソフトウェアまで、自ら設計・実装しています。オープンソース・ソフトウェアを積極的に活用しつつ、必要に応じてフルスクラッチ開発も行います。

商品企画、デザイナーと密に連携をとり、新機能や改善を早いサイクルで市場にリリースしていくことを好みます。ユーザー数の多い製品のため、リリースに対する反響が大きく、フィードバックを受け取ることが大きなモチベーションになっています。

風土としては、オープンなディスカッションやお互いを尊重するカルチャーをとても重視しています。若手の挑戦も、経験豊富なベテランの知見も、共に歓迎します。

リモートワークを重視しており、ライフスタイルに合わせて、柔軟な場所と時間の使い方ができる仕事環境を整えています。

海外拠点、とくに米国西海岸のメンバーと協業する機会が多く、グローバルなコミュニケーションが日常的に行われています。海外出張や赴任の機会があります。希望者は語学研修を受けられます。

【歓迎（WANT）】

Would you like the opportunity to work in a global energy company?

Do you enjoy taking on challenging projects?

Join our innovating Internship Program

The Baker Hughes Internship is designed to enable students either pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree or recently graduated to gain hands-on work experience as the foundation of their professional lives. Our internships will give you first-hand insights into the processes, systems, and practices that are aligned to ensure customer needs are met through flawless execution and the application of leading-edge technology.

Partner with the best

You’ll participate in focused training, team meetings, work on projects, and present your results. During your internship, you will be supported by a buddy and your manager who will ensure you have valuable learning experience. You can expect to receive coaching and mentoring to enable you to complete assignments and projects to develop your learning and skillset.

You will also have the opportunity to become familiar with the Health, Safety, and Environment (HS&E) and culture of Baker Hughes, as well as our strong commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion.

As part of the Compatibility & Coating Solutions team, you will support hands-on laboratory activities focused on coatings and materials characterization. This internship offers practical experience in coating application and testing, microstructural characterization, evaluation of mechanical and corrosion performance, analysis of experimental results, and technical reporting.

As an intern, you'll be responsible for:

• Performing hands-on laboratory activities related to coatings and coating technologies.

• Supporting coating application and laboratory testing activities.

• Characterizing coating microstructure using microscopy and other appropriate laboratory techniques.

• Evaluating coating performance, including mechanical properties and corrosion behavior.

• Analyzing experimental results and preparing clear technical summaries and reports.

• Supporting activities across coating technologies, which may include thermal spray, plating, and other coating processes.

• Organizing test data and contributing to consistent, high-quality laboratory documentation.

• Operating in compliance with laboratory Quality, Safety, and HSE procedures.

Fuel your passion

To be successful in this role you will:

• Be currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Materials Science & Engineering, Chemistry/Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering with a materials focus, or a related field.

• Have maintained a GPA grade greater than or equal to 3.0 out of 4.0 or the equivalent in your country.

• Have an interest in coatings, materials characterization, and hands-on laboratory work.

• Demonstrate strong analytical thinking and attention to detail.

• Have good written and verbal communication skills in English.

• Show curiosity, motivation, and a hands-on approach to laboratory work.

• Be able to legally work in the country that you are applying in, without company sponsorship or time restriction.

Through this internship, you will have the opportunity to develop:

• Practical experience in coating application, testing, and characterization within an industrial materials laboratory.

• Hands-on experience in physical and mechanical characterization microscopy and chemical analysis techniques

• Understanding of relationships between coating microstructure, mechanical properties, and corrosion performance.

• Exposure to coating technologies, potentially including thermal spray, plating processes and aluminide diffusive coatings.

• Experience analyzing experimental results and preparing technical reports.

• Familiarity with industrial laboratory practices, quality standards, and HSE requirements.

Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone. In this role, we may be able to offer flexible working patterns. Talk to us about your desired working options when you apply.

Working with us

Working at Baker Hughes means being at the forefront of the energy transition. Our people are diverse, ambitious, and collaborative. We're on a mission to redefine the energy sector by unlocking the power of engineering, data, and science.

The fixed allowance for this position will be between this range: 600 - 1000 € gross monthly. The allowance will be established in accordance with criteria related to the candidate’s academic status and their distance from the workplace.

The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Intern/ Trainee/Apprentice
